instructions: PhotoCraft image editor. Start with doc_new/doc_open, discover ids and parameter docs with command_list, edit with command_run or command_batch (one history step per command). Inspect with doc_inspect and render_preview; doc_save writes native .pcraft or exports by extension. File paths are relative to the read/write roots granted at launch. ui_inspect/ui_screenshot and other ui_* tools require bridge mode. Read photocraft://document and photocraft://commands for live JSON state.

tools.name: command_batch
tools.description: Run several engine commands in one call, in order (fewer round trips). Returns {completed, failed, results:[{ok, result|error}]}; stops at the first error unless stop_on_error is false. Not an atomic transaction: earlier successful steps stay applied (no rollback).

tools.name: command_list
tools.description: List engine commands. Returns a JSON array (no wrapper object) of {id, label, menu: [path], shortcut: string|null, params: doc string, enabled: bool, disabledReason: string|null, needsDocument: bool}. `disabledReason` says why a command is off (null when enabled); `needsDocument` is true when it is off because no document is open: create or open one first (doc_new, doc_open).

tools.name: command_run
tools.description: Run an engine command by id with JSON params (see command_list). Returns the command's JSON result. Long commands (filters, Content-Aware Fill/Scale, Photomerge, brush import) wait to finish unless `wait` is false: then they run as a background job and the result is {job: id} (see jobs_list, jobs_cancel).

tools.name: control_call
tools.description: Bridge mode: call any control-protocol method (docs/control-protocol.md) with raw params.

tools.name: doc_close
tools.description: Close a document (default: the active one) without saving.

tools.name: doc_export
tools.description: Export the document to another format (same as doc_save with an explicit path/format).

tools.name: doc_export_data_sets
tools.description: Export every data set of the document as its own flattened file beneath the write root (the capability-scoped Export Data Sets). The batch is planned first, so colliding filenames are refused before any file is written.

tools.name: doc_export_layers
tools.description: Export each exported layer of the document as its own file beneath the write root (the capability-scoped Layers to Files). A file that already exists is an error, not an overwrite.

tools.name: doc_import_data_sets
tools.description: Import a data set CSV from the read root into the document (the capability-scoped Import Variable Data Sets).

tools.name: doc_inspect
tools.description: Document state as JSON: layer tree (top to bottom), history, selection, active layer.

tools.name: doc_new
tools.description: Create a new document (defaults: 1920x1080 RGB 8-bit white).

tools.name: doc_open
tools.description: Open an image or document file and make it active. Returns index, size and import warnings.

tools.name: doc_place
tools.description: Place a file into the document as a Smart Object layer (Place Embedded), reading `path` beneath the read root. `scale` (percent), `fit` and `center` are the command's own.

tools.name: doc_render_preview
tools.description: Render the flattened document and return it as a PNG image (bridge mode: window screenshot).

tools.name: doc_save
tools.description: Save the document. `.pcraft` is the lossless native format (incremental); other extensions (psd, png, jpg, tif, webp, exr, …) export. Without `path` only a PSD, PSB or .pcraft document is written back to its own         file. Returns warnings about anything the format cannot hold.

tools.name: doc_select
tools.description: Make the document at `index` active.

tools.name: jobs_cancel
tools.description: Cancel a background job by id (or every running job when `job` is omitted). The document is left unchanged.

tools.name: jobs_list
tools.description: List background jobs: running ones with progress (0-1), message and elapsed time, then the last few that ended (state done|failed|cancelled with their result or error). Finished jobs are applied first.

tools.name: render_preview
tools.description: Render a bounded flattened PNG preview (bridge mode: app window screenshot).

tools.name: session_list
tools.description: List open documents (index, name, size, dirty) and the active index.

tools.name: ui_inspect
tools.description: Bridge mode: full UI state of the live app (tool, panels, views, dialogs, windows). For the menu tree, call `control_call` with method `ui.menu.list`.

tools.name: ui_menu_invoke
tools.description: Bridge mode: activate a menu item by id.

tools.name: ui_pointer
tools.description: Bridge mode: send pointer events (document coordinates) to the active tool; with a Color Picker open they sample the image into it instead.

tools.name: ui_screenshot
tools.description: Bridge mode: screenshot of the live app window as PNG.

tools.name: ui_set
tools.description: Bridge mode: change UI state (tool, panels, dock, zoom, center, fit, theme, brush settings; see `fields`). Unknown fields are an error.
